title: Version 1.1.0 - Premium UI/UX Redesign
notes:
• Complete UI/UX Modernization: Redesigned all 20+ screens with a premium commercial aesthetic following Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Linear minimal style
• New Design System: 8-point spacing grid, clean 14px card radii, refined color palette (#172554 Navy & #526DAB secondary), and dynamic light/dark/nightfall/sakura themes
• Modern Bento Grid Dashboard: Personalized greeting, attendance overview, timetable preview, and quick access navigation
• Redesigned Core Screens: Timetable, Attendance, Mess Menu, Outings, Marks, Exams, Profile, GPA, and Settings completely modernized
• Zero Disruption to Data: All backend APIs, credentials, session management, and features preserved 100%
